{{Conjecture|legends}}
The [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassans]], a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Sanyassa IV]],<ref name="EndorModdell">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref> used '''[[Hieroglyphics|hieroglyphs]]''' to write their [[Sanyassan (language)|own language]]. In a scouting report to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Pfilbee Jhorn]] mentions the Sanyassan hieroglyphs he saw on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. According to the sergeant, such characters were crudely carved in stones around the entranceway of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Terak]]'s [[Terak's Keep|castle]], but he could not interpret them.<ref name="ISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>
